fluff.overview: The Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery assigns conventional infantry to garrison roles across its military districts, with district regulars often fielding extra platoons to secure worlds that BattleMech forces cannot permanently garrison. Jump infantry carry jump packs that make them the most mobile troops in the DCMS inventory for urban and broken terrain fighting. The ability to bypass obstacles and seize elevated positions gives these platoons a tactical value that district commanders prize, particularly on heavily built-up garrison worlds where conventional movement is restricted. Armed with standard assault rifles, the cheapest and most widely manufactured personal weapon in the Inner Sphere. Effective range is limited, but any world with basic industry can produce and stockpile them in quantity, and resupply is rarely a concern even on remote garrison posts.
